name: Library lights
summary: Who's at the library tonight, drawn as the building at night: a friend studying there is a lit window with their face and a lamp that says locked in, on a break or come say hi; tap a dark window to sit there, tap yours to change your lamp.
useWhen: 'who's at fenwick rn' or 'anyone at the library?'
finding friends to study near during exam weeks
letting the group know you're studying and whether to come say hi
dontUseWhen: planning a study session at a set time (use meeting-time or lobby)
a place that isn't one building with floors (use a map or a poll)

floors.description: 3 to 5 floor names, ground floor first

status.description: 0 locked in, 1 on a break, 2 come say hi
